checks.procedure: helm install with image.requireDigest=true, secrets created out of band, KeyProvider and ledger encryption on
checks.passCriteria: Ready within the 300 s startup budget; helm test passes; deploy-verify.mjs reports all five checks PASS with the pinned key; manifests contain @sha256: and no change-me

checks.procedure: Render with a change-me value, with requireDigest but no digest, and with replicaCount=2
checks.passCriteria: Each install exits non-zero with the chart's message; nothing is created

checks.procedure: Seed on version N-1, then helm upgrade to N
checks.passCriteria: Pre-upgrade chain prefix byte-identical; new migrations applied once; ledger verifies; helm test and deploy-verify pass; downtime recorded

checks.procedure: Upgrade to a test image whose migration throws
checks.passCriteria: Pod never Ready; ledger file hash unchanged; helm rollback restores service

checks.procedure: helm rollback from N to N-1 with no schema change
checks.passCriteria: Governed turn passes; receipts issued before the rollback still verify

checks.procedure: Roll back after N added a schema version
checks.passCriteria: N-1 refuses the newer schema with a clear error, or reads it by design; restoring the pre-upgrade backup works; PRAGMA integrity_check returns ok

checks.procedure: amc backup create during writes, restore into a new namespace and volume
checks.passCriteria: amc backup verify passes; restored ledger verifies; restored head is a prefix of the source chain

checks.procedure: Delete the volume after the agreed backup cadence, then restore
checks.passCriteria: Measured RPO and RTO within targets.json

checks.procedure: Flip one byte; withhold the KeyProvider; restore into another tenant
checks.passCriteria: Each refused with a typed error; no partial workspace left

checks.procedure: Force-delete the pod during a consequential fixture action
checks.passCriteria: Action ends completed or outcome_unknown and is never re-dispatched; the fixture's system of record shows no duplicate effect

checks.procedure: Cordon and drain the node
checks.passCriteria: Pod Ready elsewhere with its volume, or the documented PDB procedure works

checks.procedure: Fill the volume
checks.passCriteria: Protected effects denied with a reason; no corruption once space is freed

checks.procedure: Block the KeyProvider
checks.passCriteria: No new protected effects; recovery without restart once restored

checks.procedure: Kill the Postgres primary (HA mode only)
checks.passCriteria: Appends fail closed, no chain fork, service resumes; RTO recorded

checks.procedure: Stop the scraper or OTLP endpoint
checks.passCriteria: Execution continues; mandatory evidence persists; dropped telemetry reported

checks.procedure: Export a bundle and verify it on a machine with no network, using the standalone verifier and the published trust list
checks.passCriteria: Genuine bundle "valid as of T"; tampered, forged-embedded-key, unpinned-issuer and revoked-key fixtures fail

checks.procedure: Download exported retention segments
checks.passCriteria: Hashes, pinned signatures and segment chaining verify without cluster access

checks.procedure: Tenant A's user calls every tenant-B route listed in src/studio/openapi.ts
checks.passCriteria: All 401 or 403; no B data in any response

checks.procedure: Present A's lease and agent token to B's gateway, toolhub and Studio
checks.passCriteria: Refused

checks.procedure: Cross-tenant evidence fixture (P1-11)
checks.passCriteria: No pass; B's verifier rejects A's events

checks.procedure: B's pod reads A's volume, database role or schema; pod-to-pod traffic across namespaces
checks.passCriteria: Permission denied; NetworkPolicy blocks the traffic

checks.procedure: Generate guard events and Studio stream messages in A
checks.passCriteria: Never visible in B
